mika_customer: Hey team — just noticed our org (acct_acmeML) had a promo credit applied yesterday but the balance dropped to 0 after a single small request. Dashboard shows 120 promo credits remaining, but the billing invoice shows 0 and usage page shows a -120 adjustment. Can someone check? Request id: req_01GXYZ, time: 2025-11-03T14:12:05Z.
asha_support: Sorry about that — that sounds wrong. I can take a look. Can you paste the full request id(s) and the org id? Also did you do any manual top-ups?
mika_customer: org id is org_acme_ml, no manual top-ups. Another request id: req_01GXYA. Only one generation call, prompt ~20 tokens.
asha_support: thanks. tagging billing/eng: @sam_billing @jake_engineer — can you check if promo credits were applied in the wrong order or double-counted?
sam_billing: pinging in. At a glance we have two places where credit ordering logic lives (metering service vs billing reconciler). Can you share the raw event id if available (evt_...) or the invoice id? Also: did you see any webhook retries?
mika_customer: I grabbed the publish event from our side: evt_pub_9b7, and invoice id inv_2025_11_03_ACME. No webhooks on our end.
billing-bot: Promo credit invoker: promo_2025_fall for org_acme_ml expired=2025-10-31T23:59:59Z applied=2025-11-03T14:12:06Z amount=120 status=consumed
jake_engineer: quick thought — we shipped a small change to credit-priority last week that flips order (reserved -> promo) under certain load flags. If the reconciler and realtime meter disagree, you can see a transient negative balance in UI. Sam, can you check reconciler logs for evt_pub_9b7?
sam_billing: looking... reconciler shows: "evt_id":"evt_pub_9b7","org":"org_acme_ml","apply_sequence":["reserved","promo"],"final_balance":0,"delta":-120". Hmm that "apply_sequence" seems reversed vs expectation.
asha_support: Mika — can you reproduce quickly? Jake, what would a repro look like from an end user?
jake_engineer: simplest repro: curl to /v1/generate with Authorization: Bearer <key> and set header X-Org-ID: org_acme_ml. Example: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "X-Org-ID: org_acme_ml" -d '{"prompt":"hello","max_tokens":10}'``` Run once and then check GET /v1/usage?range=24h. If you see promo delta -120 after a single small call that's the bug.
mika_customer: I can run that now in a dev workspace and report back.
sam_billing: FYI reconciler log snippet for evt_pub_9b7: "apply_attempts":2,"picked_order":"reserved_first","promo_marked_consumed":true,"invoice_delta":-120,"note":"fallback path triggered due to missing reserved bucket metadata". That fallback might be the culprit.
asha_support: Thanks — Sam, can you escalate to ops for a manual credit adjustment and mark this org for rollback? We should avoid auto-consume until fixed.
sam_billing: I'll file an internal billing ticket and queue manual credit restore of 120 promo credits to org_acme_ml (adj_id adj_20251103_001). Also flagging for rollback of last reconciler deploy.
jake_engineer: I'll prepare a small hotfix to ensure the apply_sequence honors promo-first for promos that are not expired. Also adding a reconciliation job to re-run last 24h events for affected orgs.
asha_support: Mika — we'll add 120 credits back immediately and follow up once the reconciler rollback/hotfix is in. Sorry for the disruption. :pray:
mika_customer: thank you. Appreciate the fast follow-up. Will run the repro curl and post the output if I see the same.
sam_billing: closing loop: manual credit adj_id adj_20251103_001 applied at 2025-11-03T15:20:00Z, balance now matches dashboard. We'll keep the rollback ticket open until the hotfix merges.
asha_support: I'll convert this thread into a support case and attach the reconciliation traces. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
